exceptions.detail: Computed dynamic specifier needs explicit admission
exceptions.reason: The test loads the workerd-only Worker entry through a constant path after the loader hook is registered, so the Node-side project does not type-check the workerd module. The specifier is one reviewed constant, never input. Replace it with a literal specifier when the Node test project can type-check the Worker entry.

exceptions.detail: Computed dynamic specifier needs explicit admission
exceptions.reason: The test loads the workerd-only Durable Object modules through constant paths so the Node-side project does not type-check them. Every specifier is a reviewed constant in the test file, never input. Replace them with literal specifiers when the Node test project can type-check the modules.

exceptions.detail: Manual varint or binary reader/writer logic
exceptions.reason: The CLOUD.69 Worker correlation reader extracts only RequestMeta.correlationId from the client frame with a minimal handwritten varint reader. It predates HAR.40, lies outside this task's write scope and is owned by CLOUD.69. It must be replaced by a reviewed generated reader before this exception expires. HAR.40 registers it only because the ported WP-05.03 wire-codec rule (GOV.10 successor, HarnessArchitectureRules) scans all Worker release code under worker/, and HAR.40 does not change this file.

exceptions.detail: Manual varint or binary reader/writer logic
exceptions.reason: A test-only encoder builds client protobuf frames as input for the CLOUD.69 correlation reader. It produces test bytes only, is never shipped and expires with the reader exception HAR40-EX-4. HAR.40 registers it because the ported wire-codec rule covers the test tree of the Worker; HAR.40 does not change this file.
